examples.title: List platform attributes
examples.description: Given an authenticated OpenTDF SDK, list attributes in an existing namespace. These examples use the SDK's native host clients; documentation generation does not create or run those clients. The illustrative response represents an empty namespace.

snippets.code:
from opentdf_tdf3.protocol.policy.attributes import attributes_pb2

request = attributes_pb2.ListAttributesRequest(namespace="example.com")
response = await sdk.attributes.list_attributes_async(request)
